# Terse

> Terse is a macOS + Windows token optimization tool that reduces AI prompt costs by 40-70% through intelligent compression, duplicate tool call detection, redundant file read flagging, and real-time per-turn cost tracking across Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Aider, and more. It runs 100% on-device with zero cloud dependency.

## Key Facts
- Reduces token usage by 40-70% on verbose prompts and up to 89% on CLI output
- 20+ optimization techniques in a 7-stage pipeline
- Auto-detects Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Aider, Cline, Roo Code agent sessions
- Model-aware pricing: tracks costs for Claude Opus 4, Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5, GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5
- 400+ built-in typo corrections, 130+ phrase-shortening rules
- 3 modes: Soft (typo-fix only), Normal (filler removal), Aggressive (max compression)
- Pricing: Free (50/week), Pro $4.99/mo (unlimited), Premium $99/mo (teams)
- macOS + Windows, built with Tauri + Rust + Swift
- CLAUDE.md rule generation from session patterns
- Live agent session monitoring: per-turn cost, duplicate tool call detection, context fill meter

## Pricing
- Free: 50 optimizations/week, 1 session, all 3 modes, spell correction
- Pro ($4.99/mo): Unlimited optimizations, 3 sessions, agent monitoring, CLAUDE.md generation, 2 devices, 30-day free trial
- Premium ($99/mo): Unlimited everything, unlimited devices, priority support, 30-day free trial
